notes: Completes the two bulk actions deferred from listing-workspace-ux, both of which needed backend. Founder scoped this explicitly on 2026-08-04 ('start and complete this listing related things including backend', then picked 'the 2 deferred bulk actions' over the wider listing roadmap). Two additive brand-scoped endpoints, no migration: POST /brands/me/listing-products/move and POST /brands/me/offers/:id/products. Design decisions taken from the real code, not assumed: (1) a move rewrites all FOUR node-derived columns (category_node_id, category_key, super_category, section) because insertProducts derives all four and `section` is what category-scoped offers match on; (2) SKU is a brand-level sequence with no category component, so moves never invalidate SKUs or variants_json; (3) move eligibility runs through taxonomy.validateItem, the same gate as create/edit, and sizes are checked against the TARGET leaf's size system using the SIZE_SYSTEMS the backend already owns for Excel templates (newly exported rather than copied); (4) attach is limited to discount/volume offers scoped to products, because offer.service.js resolveScope/filterItemsByScope means bundle/bogo/free_gift configs are not flat lists and store/category-scoped offers ignore their products array — attaching there would be a silent no-op; (5) a legacy no-scope empty-products offer is refused because resolveScope treats it as store-wide and attaching would silently shrink a store-wide discount. The merged config passes through validateOfferConfig, the same shared validator as offer create/update. Both endpoints answer per product; the UI names every refusal. UI-governed (brand-web), not Mobile-governed.
